title: Implement named forbid/layers rule validation
summary: Commit 8d6761e adds parse_rules to scanner/src/dogwatch/rules.py and adds the new scanner/tests/test_rules.py with 70 tests. Commit 4978c66 is a separate one-line edit to scanner/tests/test_validate.py:204 that drops 'rules' from the seam-foundation entity-only guard. The operator authorized this under option A of the validator-guard escalation (events.jsonl line 27), which names exclude-, rules- and contracts-validation. It mirrors the accepted exclude commit b4da9b2. make test-scanner (345 passed), make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures (9 passed) all exit 0.
